items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: And then he knew “Footprints,” and I showed him a little Montuno, like “Oye Como Va” type of thing.

ctx.x: Do you feel at all put on the spot when you get to these things to try to be able to — I’ve started this question badly — but I guess I almost envision myself in that position of trying to think of oh gosh, Roland Hanna, he probably knows a zillion things, now what’s in my repertoire that I can match with his. Is that a problem for you?

No. I think within that timeline there’s something that we know together. And then he just mentioned of course, which I forgot about, like “Autumn Leaves,” and “Carnival” and all those things. So just those two tunes alone could be an hour, depending on the stretch. And then he knew “Footprints,” and I showed him a little Montuno, like “Oye Como Va” type of thing.
Oh yeah? Well that will add a different flavor to these things.
